title: flywheel: orch_doctor input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_doctor instead; removed in v4.0] Run an 11-check health sweep of the flywheel environment: MCP connectivity, agent-mail liveness, required/optional CLIs (br/bv/ntm/cm), node version, git status, dist drift, orphaned worktrees, and checkpoint validity. Read-only — never mutates checkpoint or state. Returns a DoctorReport with per-check severity (green/yellow/red).
